result.topic_en: Gauss rewrites an infinite-product expression for x = (mm−nn)/(16 m′ μ (m″/μ)^{1/2}(m‴/μ)^{1/4}…), apparently from the arithmetic-geometric mean, and notes that successive truncations give rapidly converging approximations because the terms m′, m″, m‴ quickly become equal.
result.transcription:
[25] $x = \frac{mm-nn}{16m'\mu\left(\frac{m''}{\mu}\right)^{\frac12}\cdot\left(\frac{m'''}{\mu}\right)^{\frac14}\cdot\left(\frac{m^{IV}}{\mu}\right)^{\frac18}}\ldots$
[-$= \frac{mm-nn}{16m'm''^{\frac12}\cdot m'''^{\frac14}\cdot m^{IV\frac18}\ldots}$-]
[-$= \frac{mm-nn}{16m'\sqrt{m''\sqrt{m'''}}}$-]
wofür man auch schreiben kann
$x = \frac{mm-nn}{16m'm'}\cdot\frac{m'}{m''}\left(\frac{m''}{m'''}\right)^{\frac12}\left(\frac{m'''}{m^{IV}}\right)^{\frac14}\left(\frac{m^{IV}}{m^{V}}\right)^{\frac18}\ldots$
oder
$x = \frac{mm-nn}{16m'm''}\cdot\left(\frac{m''}{m'''}\right)^{\frac12}\cdot\left(\frac{m'''}{m^{IV}}\right)^{\frac14}\cdot\left(\frac{m^{IV}}{m^{V}}\right)^{\frac18}\ldots$

[-$x = \frac{mm-nn}{16m'm'}$-]
[-Ist erst $m'''$ von $m''$ nicht verschieden so ist-]
[-$x = \frac{mm-nn}{16m'm''}$-]
[-Ist erst $m^{IV}$ von $m'''$ nicht verschieden-]
Man erhält so jenachdem die [-Gleichheit Unmerklichkeit-] {+Ungleichheit+} der Glieder [-sich-] bei $m''$,
$m''', m^{IV}, m^{V}$ u.s.w. sich [-zuerst-] {+zuerst+}[?] zeigt die Ausdrücke
$x = \frac{mm-nn}{16m'm''}$

methods.what: Infinite product expression for x in terms of the successive means m′, m″, m‴, …
Rewriting the product as ratios of successive terms with exponents 1/2, 1/4, 1/8
Truncated approximations via nested square roots, used once the terms become numerically equal
